name: Small modern house (abandoned)
description: Abandoned and overgrown: Single-storey modern house, 9 x 7.2 m: white render with a dark vertical timber-clad bedroom wing, a flat roof behind a low parapet with an aluminium coping, a steel door canopy, aluminium windows with precast sills, a full-height glazed slider to the rear. Enterable: bedroom, bathroom, living room and kitchen in a row joined near the rear wall; front door into the living room, back door from the kitchen.
